old: - **Uncollected visits:** visits closed by the auto check-out, left unpaid and not written off, the unpriced ones included (2026-10-20, #97; #100).
new: - **Uncollected visits:** visits closed by the auto check-out, left unpaid and not written off, the unpriced ones included (2026-10-20, #97; #100); and a priced visit closed by hand with no customer that owes again after a void (2026-10-24, #PRNUM).

old: - a visit left unpaid at a manual check-out, or at a later payment, has a customer (the payment and the check-out are separate writes; a visit closed by the auto check-out may have none: it is uncollected);
new: - a visit left unpaid at a manual check-out, or at a later payment, has a customer (the payment and the check-out are separate writes; a visit closed by the auto check-out may have none: it is uncollected), unless a void leaves it owing: it is then uncollected (2026-10-24, #PRNUM);

old: a voided payment counts for nothing. A manual check-out's visit is never listed: its unpaid rest is a customer's debt. `meta` the pagination.
new: a voided payment counts for nothing. A manual check-out's visit is never listed: its unpaid rest is a customer's debt; unless a void leaves one with no customer owing — a priced visit closed by hand with no customer that owes again after a void is listed (2026-10-24, #PRNUM). `meta` the pagination.

old: - **Uncollected visits** (closed by the auto check-out and left unpaid) → `payments`,
new: - **Uncollected visits** (closed by the auto check-out and left unpaid, and a priced visit closed by hand with no customer that owes again after a void, 2026-10-24, #PRNUM) → `payments`,

old: - Answers a space's uncollected visits: closed by the auto check-out, not fully paid and not written off, with what was paid and what is still owed.
new: - Answers a space's uncollected visits: closed by the auto check-out, or a priced visit closed by hand with no customer that owes again after a void, not fully paid and not written off, with what was paid and what is still owed.

old: **The uncollected visits.** One query and its count over the space's visits closed by the auto check-out and not written off,
new: **The uncollected visits.** One query and its count over the space's visits closed by the auto check-out, or closed by hand, priced, with no customer, and not written off,

old: *Why:* the old read sent every settled id back as bound parameters, growing with every auto-closed visit ([finding 113](../architecture/findings/113-the-uncollected-read-grows-with-every-auto-closed-visit.md)). 2026-10-21, #102.
new: *Why:* the old read sent every settled id back as bound parameters, growing with every auto-closed visit ([finding 113](../architecture/findings/113-the-uncollected-read-grows-with-every-auto-closed-visit.md)). 2026-10-21, #102. Revised: they include a priced visit closed by hand with no customer, which only a void leaves owing, in the same query. *Why:* such a visit owes and would show in no list, no debt and no count; the uncollected list offers what it needs («تسجيل دينًا», a payment, the write-off). An unpriced one closed by hand stays the unpriced visits' (S1 of the plan, with the owner's correction). 2026-10-24, #PRNUM.
